snip.t: Which of the following statements is NOT true about mitochondrial properties that support chemiosmotic hypothesis of ATP synthesis;
There is no high energy intermediate linking electron transport and ATP synthesis
Mitochondria are involved in ATP synthesis, partial heme synthesis, thermogenesis (heat release from ATP breakdown via uncoupling proteins), and beta-oxidation (breakdown) of fatty acids.
Oxidative Phosphorylation: This is the major pathway for ATP synthesis in aerobic organisms.
snip.s: Medical Biochemistry, Genetics, and Molecular Biology — Notes

snip.t: In the microcirculation, inadequate capillary hydrostatic pressure and cellular hypoxia shift metabolism from the mitochondrial Krebs cycle to anaerobic glycolysis, producing lactic acid, reducing adenosine triphosphate ($ATP$) synthesis, and impairing the $Na^+/K^+$ ATPase pump.
Respiration involves the transfer of electrons from fuel molecules to a terminal electron acceptor, releasing energy for ATP synthesis.
